content_of_post_to_comment: English isn’t my first language. When I write, strange words show up on the page. I’m never quite sure if that’s actually something people say in English, or if I just made it up by translating something German word by word. If Claude were a person, it would probably roll on the floor laughing reading my drafts. Does your AI also save you from the odd phrases that make no sense?
comment: There’s a funny tradeoff here: AI can make your English sound more natural while quietly sanding off the quirks that make your voice yours. The trick is knowing which odd phrases are mistakes and which are discoveries.
